source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The regular battle theme: energetic, fast and heroic, pumping adrenaline, a catchy lead that the player will hum for years. Driving rock-orchestra hybrid in classic 16-bit JRPG fashion. Tempo 164 BPM, 4/4 time, key of E minor. Instrumentation: bright synth lead doubled with strings, electric bass riff, string stabs, brass hits, driving rock drum kit, timpani accents. Form: 2-bar punchy intro, main riff and melody, a contrasting bridge, back to the main melody. Duration: 75 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
